attr.title: Rich4 SDL (Experimental)
attr.desc: Experimental SDL reimplementation of Richman 4. Requires user-supplied V3.11 game data and a CJK font. Device compatibility is not yet verified.
attr.inst: Copy Data.mkf, Map.mkf, Panel.mkf, Effect.mkf, Speaking.mkf, Jump.mkf and Help.mkf into ports/rich4/assets/original/. Supply a CJK font at ports/rich4/assets/fonts/rich4.ttc. Optional OGG/WAV music goes into ports/rich4/assets/music/. See rich4.md for music layout and controls.
